content: Eeliyaasanne Ba7aale Nabeta
Iri bukonna aggin heedzantho laythan, Goday Eeliyaasako, “Bada kawa Akaabas qonca. Ta biittan ira bukisana” yaagis.
Eeliyaasi Akaabas qoncanaw dendidi bis. He wode Samaaren wolqaama koshi keyis.
Akaabi ba kawo gadhuwa aawatethan aysiya Abdiyu xeegis. Abdiyuy Godaa minthidi ammaniya asi.
Elzabeela Godaa sunthan nabeta wodhida wode Abdiyuy entafe xeetata ekidi, ishataman ishataman shaakidi, gongolo giddon qosidi, kathinne haathe immishe gam7is.
Akaabi Abdiyu xeegidi, “Maata demmidi paratanne baqulota hayqope ashshanaw biittan pultoy de7iya bessinne shaafa gaxan ubbaa ba” yaagis.
Enti biittan awu bagga baaneko shaaketidi ekin, Akaabi issi ogiya oykidi barka bis; Abdiyuy hara oge oykidi barka bis.
Abdiyuy ba ogiya oykidi bishin, Heko, Eeliyaasi iyara gahetis. Abdiyuy Eeliyaasa eridi ba som7uwan gufannidi, “Ta godaw Eeliyaasa, haysi nenee?” yaagis.
Eeliyaasi, “Ee tana; neeni bada, heko, Eeliyaasi haysan de7ees yaagada ne godaas oda” yaagis.
Abdiyuy zaaridi, “Ta nena ay qohin ne tana ne aylliya hayqo gada Akaaba kushen aathada immay?

Goday, ne de7o Xoossay ero! Ta goday nena koyana mela kiitiboonna biitti woyko kawotethi baawa. Enti, ‘Eeliyaasi haysan baawa’ giya wode ne yan baynaysi tuma gideysa eranaw Akaabi deriya ayseysata caaqisees.
Ha77i neeni, ‘Bada, Eeliyaasi haysan de7ees’ yaagada oda” yaagasa.
“Ta nena aggada biya wode Godaa Ayyaanay nena denthidi, ta eronna bessi efana. Ta Akaabas odin, I nena demmona ixiko, tana wodhana. Taani ne aylley na7atethafe doomada Godaa yayiya asi.
Elzabeela Godaa nabeta wodhida wode, taani entafe xeeta ekada, ishataman ishataman shaakada issi gongolon qosada, kathinne haathe immas. Yaatin, taani oothidabay new ta godaas odetibeennee?
Ha77i neeni, ‘Bada, heko, Eeliyaasi haysan de7ees’ yaagada oda yaagasa. Ta odiko I tana wodhana” yaagis.
Eeliyaasi, “Taani iyaw kiitetiya, Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday ero! Tuma taani hachi Akaabas qoncana” yaagis.
Abdiyuy Akaabako bidi Akaabas odin, Akaabi Eeliyaasara gahetanaw bis.
Akaabi Eeliyaasa be7ida wode, “Isra7eele biitta buqey nenee?” yaagis.
Eeliyaasi zaaridi, “Isra7eele biitta buqey tana gidonashin, Godaa kiita aggidi, Ba7aale eeqata goyinnidi, biitta buqey nenanne ne aawa soo asaa.
Ha77i, Isra7eele asa ubbaa Qarmeloosa zuma bolla taako shiisha. Elzabeeli gibira miya oyddu xeetanne ishatamu Ba7aale nabetanne oyddu xeetu Asheera nabeta issife ha bessaa shiisha” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, Akaabi kiittidi, Isra7eele asa ubbaanne nabeta Qarmeloosa zuma bolla shiishis.
Eeliyaasi shiiqida asaako bidi, “Awude gakanaw nam7u wozanan daanee? Goday Xoosse gidiko iya goyinnite; Ba7aaley Xoosse gidiko iya goyinnite” yaagis. Gidoshin, asay iyaw issi qaalaka zaaribeenna.
Hessafe guye, Eeliyaasi, “Godaa nabetape ta xalaali attas; shin Ba7aale nabeti oyddu xeetanne ishatama.

Ane nuus nam7u kormata imeto. He kormatape issuwa enti dooro; kormaa shukidi qanxeretho; ashuwa mitha bolla wotho; shin tama eethofo. Taani nam7antho korma giigisada, mitha bolla wothana; taka tama eethike.
Hinte, hinte xoossaa sunthaa xeegite; taka Godaa sunthaa xeegana. Si7idi yarshuwa miya tama kiittiya xoossay, i, Xoosse gido” yaagis. Asay, “Ne giya qofay lo77o” yaagidosona.
Hessa gisho, Eeliyaasi Ba7aale nabetako, “Hinte daro gidiya gisho, issi korma dooridi koyrottidi giigisite. Hinte xoossaa sunthaa xeegite; shin iyan tama eethofite” yaagis.

Enti bantaw imetida kormaa ekidi giigisidosona. Wontafe seeta gallas gakanaw Ba7aale sunthaa xeegidi, “Ba7aale, nuna si7a” yaagidi woossidosona. Shin si7etiya girsi baawa; zaariya asi bentibeenna. Banta giigisida yarsho bessa yuushuwan duridosona.

Sa7i seeta gallasa gidin, Eeliyaasi, “Hinte qaala dhoqu oothidi woossite! I Xoosse gidenne! Ooni eri, I qofan gelidaako woyko iyaw oosoy daridaako woyko mandaridaako woyko dhiskidaba gidiko denthanaw koshshees” yaagidi qelqisis.
Enti banta qaala dhoqu oothidi woossidosona. Kase banta goyinniya wogaada banta asatethara suuthi goggana gakanaw tooraninne mashshan bantana caddidosona.
Omarsi yarsho shiishiya wodey gakanaw enti tinbite odidosona; shin si7etiya girsi baawa; entana hayzidi zaaro immiya asi dhayis.
Hessafe guye, Eeliyaasi, “Haa taako shiiqite” yaagis. Asay iyako shiiqin, laaletida Godaa yarsho bessaa zaaridi gimbis.
Godaa qaalay Yayqoobako, “Ne sunthay Isra7eele gidana” yaagidi odida, Yayqooba nayta kochata taybuwan tammanne nam7u shuchata ekis.
Godaa sunthan he shuchata keelidi, yarsho bessi gimbidi, tammanne oyddu litiro haathe oykiya olla yarsho bessa yuushon bookis.

Hessafe guye, yarsho bessan mithi wothidi, kormaa ashuwa iya qommuwan qommuwan qanxerethidi, mithaa bolla wothis. Asaako, “Oyddu baathe haathe kunthidi, yarshuwa bollanne mithaa bolla gussite” yaagis; enti gussidosona.
Qassika, Eeliyaasi, “Nam7antho gujite” yaagis; enti nam7antho gujidosona. Qassika, Eeliyaasi, “Heedzantho gujite” yaagis; heedzantho gujidosona.
Haathay yarsho bessa yuushuwan goggidi, ollan kumis.

Omarsa yarsho shiishiya wode nabey Eeliyaasi yarsho bessaako shiiqidi haysada yaagidi woossis; “Abeeti Godaw, Abrahaame Xoossaw, Yisaaqa Xoossaw, Isra7eele Xoossaw, neeni Isra7eele biittan Xoosse gideysa, taani ne aylle gideysanne taani haysa ubbaa ne qaalan oothidaysi hachi ereto.
Abeeti Godaw, taw koya. Neeni, Goday Xoosse gideysanne enta wozanaa neeko zaarey nena gideysa ha asay erana mela taw koya!” yaagis.
Godaa tamay salope wodhidi, xuussa yarshuwa, mithaa, shuchaanne biitta mis; ollan de7iya haatha laacis.
Asa ubbay hessa be7ida wode, banta som7ora sa7an gufannidi, “Goday Xoosse! Godaa xalaali Xoosse!” yaagidosona.
Eeliyaasi, “Ba7aale nabeta oykite; entafe issi asika kessi ekofo” yaagis. Asay enta oykidosona; Eeliyaasi enta Qisoona Shaafa efidi wodhis.
Goday Ira Buksis
Eeliyaasi Akaabako, “Keyada ba; ma; uya; taani, wolqaama ira guunthi si7ayis” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, Akaabi maanawunne uyanaw bis. Shin Eeliyaasi Qarmeloosa zuma bolla keyidi, ba som7uwa ba gulbata giddo gelsidi hokis.

Eeliyaasi ba aylliyako, “Ane bada, abbaako simmada xeella” yaagis. Iya aylley bidi xeellidi, “Aybika bentenna” yaagis. Eeliyaasi ba aylliya laapun toho, “Qassika bada xeella” yaagis. Iya aylley laapun toho xeellis.
Laapunthon, “Kushe qaaqape daronna guutha shaari abbafe keyishin be7as” yaagis. Eeliyaasi, “Bada, ‘iri nena buussu diggonna mela ne para gaariyan uttada ne soo ba’ yaagada Akaabas oda” yaagis.
Guutha wodepe guye saloy kareetha shaaran dulkis; carkoy carkis; wolqaama iri bukis. Akaabi para gaariyan uttidi Izra7eela katamaa bis.
Godaa wolqay Eeliyaasa bolla wodhis. Eeliyaasi ba ma7uwa xeessan pude siqidi, Izra7eela katamaa gakanaw Akaaba sinthan woxis.
